description: District 14 is one of the fastest-growing areas in Idaho. Scott Grow has made sure the roads keep up. In recent sessions, Scott fought for and secured funding to widen Highway 16, Highway 44, and Chinden Blvd — and to extend Highway 16 to I-84. He helped pass a $1.25 billion state highway appropriation and $200 million for local highways. Those projects are underway. Scott has also prioritized Highway 55, Highway 20/26, and the Highway 16 corridor from Emmett to Highway 44 — a critical need for Gem County residents.
title: The Roads Are Getting Done. - C. Scott Grow for Idaho State Senate
